_doc: Models excluded from auto_pool_curator candidate selection. Permanent excludes — models with structural problems (tool-format mismatch, broken endpoints, TPM-too-low, etc.) that smoke-tests can't catch. Distinct from circuit-breaker cooldowns (transient quota/error issues, auto-recover). To add: append entry, deploy.sh syncs to .93 → curator picks up next run.
